observations: Three photos show a black, square-shaped console with a textured surface and the PlayStation logo in gold or bronze.
The console has four small circular holes and four triangular, square, and cross-shaped indentations on the top surface, matching the PlayStation controller layout.
The console appears to be closed and not powered on; no ports, buttons, or screen are visible.
The background is a wooden surface with a colorful abstract painting.
Watermarks 'POSTED ON JIJI' and 'WILCOX HARRY' are overlaid on all photos.

claims.claim: PS4 Pro packs in twice the GPU power of the standard PS4
claims.evidence: The photos show only the exterior of the console; no internal components, labels, or specifications are visible to verify GPU power. The claim cannot be confirmed from the images alone.
This is a subjective claim about performance and visual quality. No screen or display is shown, and no proof of functionality or image quality is provided.

risks.risk: The console may be non-functional or have internal damage not visible in photos.
risks.proof: A video showing the console powering on, booting up, and running a game or system menu.

risks.risk: The console may be a counterfeit or non-genuine unit.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the serial number and model label on the console, or a video showing the console's system settings screen.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a generic or counterfeit unit

risks.risk: The console may be missing essential accessories (e.g., power cable, HDMI cable, controller).
risks.proof: A photo showing all included accessories laid out next to the console.
